name_cn: 绍兴市凯隆裤业有限公司
main_products: Men's dress and casual trousers, T/C cargo pants, suits, vests, shirts, uniforms
woven_evidence: It specialises in men's semi-formal and casual trousers, including T/C cargo pants, which are woven bottoms.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The Zhejiang (Shaoxing) official 137th fair exhibitor list shows 绍兴市凯隆裤业有限公司, exhibitor code 160F730, Phase 3, Men's & Women's Wear, 1 booth. The 136th list (.../b026be57fdfe4d859d4395272bdd4464.pdf) shows the same entry.

notes: A directory profile says it was founded in 2007 at No. 2 Tianmu Road, Shaoxing, with 101-300 staff and 91-100% exports. US customs data shows shipments up to 2021. Its website did not resolve when fetched, and it also lists neckties.
